CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.Flight_Fare_Ext
(

 ORIGIN_COUNTRY_NAME   VARCHAR(100),
    DEST_COUNTRY_NAME     VARCHAR(100),
    FLIGHT_COUNT          INT,
    FLIGHT_FAIR_PRICE     DECIMAL(10,2)

)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'input/AirIndiaFlightFairData.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_csv_file
);
GO

DROP EXTERNAL table dbo.Flight_Fare_Ext

SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.Flight_Fare_Ext;
